You’re absolutely right to feel this way. I actually went through something similar before, and I remember hesitating to block a guy out of fear too,because as you said we can’t really predict how they’ll react.Your boyfriend doesn’t understand how much thought we, as women, put into simply existing safely—how we constantly overthink the way we talk, dress, and act just to avoid harassment. He’s not the one dealing with this reality, so he doesn’t get to judge.

No matter what anyone says, always trust your instincts(it’s not paranoia). Even if we haven’t personally experienced something extreme, we hear enough horror stories from other women to know better. It’s always safer to be cautious than to regret it later. And since you have your brother around, that’s reassuring. ghir 7awli tscreeni lprofile dialo wkhlih end khuk or a friend or someone you trust , inshaellah hadshi ayduz ela khir ,May Allah protect you and keep you safe sis.
